snippet.title: Velderis | Free Browser MMORPG | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play free in your browser: https://velderis.com/

Explore the world of Velderis, a free browser MMORPG featuring turn-based battles, quests, equipment upgrades and cooperative dungeons.

Choose your class, strengthen your gear with crystals, set your combat plan and team up to defeat challenging bosses.

No download required.


#Velderis #MMORPG #BrowserGame
